scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && prettier --check apps packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml compose.yaml eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .github README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml compose.yaml eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .github README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @study-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @study-platform/ui build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @study-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @study-platform/ui build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test
